text: Dongtian Micro forecasts 1H2026 net profit attributable to parent of 85–95 mln yuan, up 67.71%–87.44% YoY. The company cites continued business-mix improvement and strong communications demand — AI-driven data-center optics demand lifted the optical module chain, raising revenue
text_zh: 东田微预测2026年上半年归母净利润为8500万至9500万元，同比增长67.71%–87.44%。公司称受益于业务结构持续优化及通信需求旺盛——AI驱动数据中心光模块需求提振了光模块产业链，带动收入增长。
